summary_en: FY2027 year-end dividend per share increased from 30 yen to 35 yen; annual dividend raised from 60 yen to 65 yen following upward revision of full-year earnings forecast under the 20% payout ratio policy.
title_en: Notice on Revision of FY2027 Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Mitsui E&S revised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast upward on November 10, 2026. The year-end dividend per share increased from 30 yen to 35 yen, bringing the full-year dividend to 65 yen from the previously announced 60 yen. This revision followed an upward revision of the company's full-year earnings forecast disclosed in the second quarter earnings announcement released on the same day.

The company stated that its dividend distribution policy aims to balance business development through capital expenditure, research and development investment, and strengthening of shareholders' equity, while enhancing returns to shareholders. The dividend increase remains consistent with the 20% payout ratio target outlined in "Mitsui E&S Rolling Vision 2026." The company emphasized its commitment to sustained improvement in enterprise value and enhanced shareholder returns while being mindful of both the cost of shareholders' capital and the cost of debt.
